seo.title: LVMH: MaIA internal genAI assistant - 40,000 employees, ~2M requests/month (2024)
seo.meta_description: MaIA, LVMH's internal genAI assistant built on Google and OpenAI, is used by 40,000 employees for ~1.5 to 2M requests/month, including marketing content.
seo.resume_citable: MaIA, LVMH's internal genAI assistant built on Google Gemini/Imagen and OpenAI, is used by 40,000 employees for about 1.5 to 2 million requests per month, including generating marketing content and personalized customer messages.

faq.q: How many people use MaIA at LVMH?
faq.a: 40,000 employees, for on the order of 1.5 to 2 million requests per month according to PYMNTS and WWD.

faq.q: What is MaIA used for on the marketing side?
faq.a: To generate e-commerce copy, personalized customer messages and mood boards for design teams, in addition to internal research and translation.

pattern: internal enterprise genAI assistant (marketing content, personalization, research)
objectif_business: Equip the marketing, creative and retail teams of the Maisons with a group-wide genAI assistant to speed up content production, customer message personalization and internal research, without exposing the brand universe to consumer chatbots.
description: MaIA is LVMH's internal AI assistant, launched in 2024 and built on a combination of Google models (Gemini, Imagen) and OpenAI (GPT), on top of a group data foundation built with Google. It is used by 40,000 employees and handles on the order of 1.5 to 2 million requests per month. On the marketing and creative side, MaIA is used to generate e-commerce copy, personalized customer messages and mood boards for design teams, in addition to document research and translation. Some Maisons turn the platform into dedicated agents: a retail agent at Celine to answer complex questions from advisors, a customer outreach agent at Tiffany and Co. to write personalized messages. LVMH deliberately keeps these tools internal and does not put a chatbot on its sales sites.
points_cles: Internal enterprise genAI assistant for marketing, creative and retail across the LVMH Maisons.
MaIA platform built on Google (Gemini, Imagen) and OpenAI (GPT) over a group data foundation.
40,000 employees, about 1.5 to 2 million requests per month, business agents at Celine and Tiffany.
Evidence C, confirmed status: established press citing LVMH and its technology director.

niveau_preuve.justification: Two established press outlets (PYMNTS, WWD via Yahoo Finance) naming LVMH and its technology director, with concordant usage figures (40,000 employees, 1.5 to 2M requests/month). No direct financial result attached to MaIA.

stack_technique.detail: language model for text generation, translation and internal research
image generation, notably for the design teams' mood boards
second text generation foundation; MaIA routes the request to the model suited to the task
grounds the generation on the group's data and tone, with isolation from third-party models and access logging
group-wide genAI assistant used by 40,000 employees (1.5 to 2M requests per month), turned into business agents by the Maisons (Celine, Tiffany)

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Daily on-demand use; new business agents built by the Maisons as needs arise
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Group IT and technology department for the platform; marketing, creative and retail teams of the Maisons as users
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: Governed access to the group data foundation and brand data. Without a connection to internal data and brand tone, generation stays generic and unusable in luxury.

etapes.detail: A marketing or creative employee asks for copy, an image, a translation or research.
MaIA routes to Gemini, Imagen or GPT depending on the task, anchored on the group's data and tone.
A Maison turns MaIA into a dedicated agent (Celine retail, Tiffany outreach) for a targeted use.
The employee reviews and validates the content before distribution; the sales sites remain without a chatbot.

prerequis_data: reference set for brand tone and universe
access governance for sensitive data (HR, customer)
prerequis_orga: IT department to run the central platform
enterprise genAI licenses with data isolation
a liaison in each brand to build the business agents
replication.equipe: 1 IT platform team (3-5 people) + business liaisons in each brand for the dedicated agents + data governance and legal

playbook.action: Frame the data governance and two priority marketing use cases (e-commerce copy, mood boards)
playbook.livrable: v1 scope + access rules for sensitive data (HR, customer)

playbook.action: Contract the models in enterprise versions with data isolation and logging
playbook.livrable: Isolated multi-model API access, validated by security

playbook.action: Build the cross-functional assistant anchored on the data foundation and the brand tone reference
playbook.livrable: v1 assistant opened to a first group of marketing and creative users

playbook.action: Deploy more broadly, train the teams and track adoption
playbook.livrable: Requests and adoption dashboard by function

playbook.action: Turn it into business agents per brand (retail support, customer outreach), with human review before distribution
playbook.livrable: 1 to 2 dedicated agents in production in the pilot brands

replication.premiere_etape: Open an enterprise genAI assistant anchored on internal data and brand tone, with two priority marketing use cases (copy, mood boards).

statut_vivant.note: Group-wide use confirmed mid-2025, with adaptations into business agents by the Maisons (Celine, Tiffany).

transposable_ue.note: French group, internal platform built on a group data foundation. genAI use on enterprise data: GDPR framing for HR, customer and supplier data, isolation of data from third-party models (Google, OpenAI) and access logging.
